data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to communicate with WatchOS apps via Apple Watch Connectivity.
data.what_it_does: Provides a wrapper around the Watch Connectivity framework allowing Flutter iOS apps to send messages, application context, user info, and files to a paired WatchOS app. It also exposes activation state and device reachability information.
use_when: You need bidirectional communication between an iOS Flutter app and its WatchOS companion.
You want to transfer small messages, app context, user data, or files to a watch.
You need to monitor watch reachability and activation state.
avoid_when: Your app targets Android or other platforms only.
You require cross‑platform watch support (e.g., Wear OS) without separate implementations.
strengths: Uses native Watch Connectivity for reliable Apple ecosystem communication
Rich feature set: messages, context, user info, file transfer
Provides streams for activation and reachability changes
weaknesses: iOS‑only; no support for Android or web
Requires a WatchOS companion app with matching bundle ID
data.setup_notes: Add the plugin to pubspec, ensure a WatchOS companion app exists, configure bundle ID (YOUR_IOS_BUNDLE_ID.watchkitapp) and enable Watch Connectivity in Xcode.

alternatives.name: connectivity_plus
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides generic network connectivity status across platforms, but not watch‑specific communication.
